name: @lotus/host
description: Remote control bridge for Lotus Claude Agent Teams — Telegram, Slack, and more

scripts.build:vps: test -f dist/lotus-sessiond-linux-x64 || { echo 'dist/lotus-sessiond-linux-x64 is missing: run apps/desktop/scripts/build-sessiond-linux.sh (or bun run host:build:vps from the repo root)' >&2; exit 1; }; bun build src/index.ts dist/lotus-sessiond-linux-x64 --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --define LOTUS_BUILD_ID="\"$(git describe --always --dirty --tags 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD)-$(git log -1 --format=%cs)\"" --outfile=dist/lotus-remote-bin-linux-x64
scripts.build:bundle: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --define LOTUS_BUILD_ID="\"$(git describe --always --dirty --tags 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD)-$(git log -1 --format=%cs)\"" --outfile=dist/lotus-remote.mjs --format=esm --minify --external=node-pty && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --compile --define LOTUS_BUILD_ID="\"$(git describe --always --dirty --tags 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD)-$(git log -1 --format=%cs)\"" --outfile=dist/lotus-remote-bin --external=node-pty
